target_niche: AI startups and enterprise cloud infrastructure providers needing secure, lightweight telemetry services

icp.ideal_persona: CTO, Platform Engineer, or DevOps Lead responsible for observability and security
pain_points: Insecure or missing authentication for telemetry endpoints
Complex setup and scaling of metrics storage
Limited visibility into service health without heavy infrastructure
icp.primary_benefit: A plug‑and‑play FastAPI microservice that delivers authenticated telemetry with JWT and low‑overhead SQLite storage, deployable via Docker

milestone_1: Deliver a functional MVP: FastAPI service with HS256 JWT auth, SQLite schema (timestamp, metric_name, value, tags), Dockerfile, and basic unit tests
milestone_2: Production‑grade release: CI/CD pipeline, health‑check endpoints, Prometheus/OpenTelemetry integration, comprehensive documentation, and optional scaling to external DB

technical_blueprint.architecture: Stateless FastAPI container exposing /telemetry endpoint, JWT middleware for auth, SQLite file mounted as volume, optional reverse‑proxy (NGINX) for TLS termination
technical_blueprint.human_authorization_required: Docker registry credentials for image push, production host SSH keys, API keys for any external monitoring integrations
technical_blueprint.autonomous_execution_scope: Code scaffolding, test generation, Docker image build, CI workflow creation, documentation drafting

scraped_sources.title: Production Telemetry & Metrics Design in FastAPI

synthesis_summary: Research shows a gap in secure, low‑overhead telemetry for fast‑moving AI startups and cloud teams. By leveraging FastAPI, JWT HS256 auth, and SQLite, we can deliver a secure, containerized microservice that integrates easily with existing CI pipelines. The plan proceeds from a rapid MVP to a production‑ready offering with monitoring, scaling, and full documentation.
